name: Thanksgiving To Go
description: A Thanksgiving bar that fits in one bag. Bottles: bourbon (bring a 1.75 L), Koskenkorva Apple, sweet vermouth, prosecco and a bottle of red. Also: Angostura, the brown-sugar-cinnamon and honey syrups, maple syrup, sugar cubes, apple cider, cranberry, orange, lemon and lime juice, ginger beer, oranges, fresh cranberries and rosemary. The four batches are made at home and are the ones to photograph; the rest are made to order from the same bag.

drinks.note: Batch: steep it in the pitcher overnight.
Batch: mix the base at home; ginger beer and ice go in on site.
Batch: base in a pitcher; add the prosecco at the table.
Batch: bottle it the night before and freeze it.
Stirred in a mixing glass, or built in the glass at a pinch.
Shake to order; skip the egg white on the road.
For arrivals: cider and prosecco, nothing else.
For the toast, with the prosecco you brought.
No alcohol, for drivers and kids.
After dinner, if the host has a kettle.
